findings.question: Land & property registry (Title, ownership, mortgages and cadastral parcels): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Die Grundstücke werden im Grundbuch nach den in den Ländern eingerichteten amtlichen Verzeichnissen benannt (Liegenschaftskataster).
findings.quote_english: The plots of land are designated in the land register according to the official registers set up in the federal states (real estate cadastre).
findings.title: § 2 GBO - Grundbuchordnung
findings.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz / Bundesamt für Justiz (gesetze-im-internet.de)
findings.note: Official federal law portal, a different section (§ 2) from the earlier § 1 URL. The same provision names the Liegenschaftskataster (real estate cadastre), kept by the Länder, as the official register that parcels are designated by, so the cadastral-parcel part of this holding sits in a separate Länder register.

review.established: Grundbuch (land register), with parcels designated per the Länder's official cadastral registers, the Liegenschaftskataster
review.reason: §2(2) GBO, as fetched, contains the quote word for word: land parcels are recorded in the Grundbuch and named after the official registers set up in the Länder (Liegenschaftskataster), which gives the register names but not who operates them.
